TCS: T / LSB
ABS: Y / Unbound
Popups: B / Unbound

games.name: Studio Lite
games.desc:
Build your own game.  Just like Roblox Studio, but simpler and mobile friendly.  Includes tutorials to help you build and script amazing games!
 
Complete one tutorial to pass the age 20 college class in “Growing Up”.

Publish your Studio Lite game to your Roblox profile for the world to play.  All from mobile!

Robux earned, thumbs-up votes and moderation are all handled like any other game on Roblox.  Abide by Roblox’s Terms of Service.

There are a few one-time steps to enable the publish feature.  Checkmark (✔️) Publish.  See the Help button on the Publish page. For Tips, join the community below.

File, Sample... "Dance Club" includes scripts to help you play and sell emotes, animation Ids.

Toolbox includes Asset importing; Rig Builder; Animation Lite Editor.

Collaboration Lite: "Share" all or part of your game with friends (13+).

Please thumbs up for more updates and use the “Vote” feature in the game.
